notes.title: Fixed bug in Stage 14
notes.content: Some players have reported that a place in Stage 14 cannot be passed, but not everyone has this bug. Now we have fixed it and there will be no problems! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Some bug fixes and difficulty adjustments
notes.content: Welcome to Mess Adventure 2.  This game is basically responded well, but still goes with some few bugs and difficult levels.  We have reduced the difficulty of inference for some levels and kept the original designs, that you may get a pass easier.  Thanks for your kind support!  Any other suggestions, please do not hesitate to contact me!
